title: classification_exposure
description: A rating classification and its exposure amount for a risk and state: a general liability class with its sales or payroll, or a workers' compensation class with its payroll. Estimated at inception, replaced by audited amounts at audit.

class_code_value_id.description: NCCI/state bureau class code or ISO GL class code.

rate.description: Rate per unit of exposure (e.g. per $100 payroll, per $1,000 sales).

rate_per_units.description: Units of exposure the rate applies to: 100, 1000, ...

is_if_any.description: Class listed on an 'if any' basis with no estimated exposure.

premium_audit_id.description: Audit that established the audited exposure.

effective_date.description: First business date this row applies.

expiration_date.description: Business date this row stops applying (exclusive); null while open-ended.

added_by_transaction_id.description: Policy transaction that introduced this row.

removed_by_transaction_id.description: Policy transaction that removed or superseded this row.
